Careful who you let in your car

M-G-M presents the GREAT STORY in CINEMASCOPE and COLOR

Sarah Palin's Unprecedented Rise to Political Prominence
Self - on The Tonight Show (archive footage)
Self - Former Alaskan state legislator (archive footage)

His adventure made him a hero.His showmanship made him a legend.

A TRICK OF FATE MADE THEM BOTH ENEMY AND LOVER.

A Film about hope, fear and digital culture

La meilleure amie de la mère de Vanessa

Thrown out of Heaven... They'll take you to Hell...

With Wedding Gift of Stolen Silver (uncredited)

This is a real story... Because it belongs to all of us.

When the moon is up the fun begins.
